recognize_zh: 血液抹片下方有一顆巨大血小板，大小與周圍紅血球相當，中央有紫紅色顆粒區、周邊為淡染透明區，旁邊中性球顆粒正常，這種紅血球大小的巨血小板是 Bernard-Soulier 症候群的典型表現。
features: Giant platelet approximately the size of adjacent red cells
Clustered central purple granules (granulomere) with a pale gray peripheral hyalomere
Band/segmented neutrophil with normal cytoplasmic granulation and no visible Döhle-like inclusions
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor
Low-resolution, enlarged image limits fine granule detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a giant platelet comparable in size to the surrounding red cells, with a central aggregate of purple granules and a pale hyalomere. An adjacent neutrophil shows normal granulation without Döhle-like inclusions, and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. No platelet clumping is present in this field. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia as seen in Bernard-Soulier syndrome, confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced platelet agglutination that does not correct with normal plasma and decreased CD42b/CD42a expression by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets occur with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin agglutination.
Also shows large platelets and thrombocytopenia but has enhanced, not absent, low-dose ristocetin-induced aggregation due to gain-of-function GPIBA variants.
Large platelets are pale and agranular rather than containing a well-granulated granulomere.
